Class PWMMotorController

java.lang.Object
org.wpilib.hardware.motor.MotorSafety
org.wpilib.hardware.motor.PWMMotorController
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable, MotorController, TelemetryLoggable
Direct Known Subclasses:
Koors40, PWMSparkFlex, PWMSparkMax, PWMTalonFX, PWMTalonSRX, PWMVenom, PWMVictorSPX, Spark, SparkMini, Talon, VictorSP
public abstract class PWMMotorController extends MotorSafety implements MotorController, TelemetryLoggable, AutoCloseable
Common base class for all PWM Motor Controllers.
